---

### **Twitter API Functions**

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `authenticate_twitter` | Log in a user with username & password |
| `post_tweet` | Post a tweet (content, tags, mentions) |
| `retweet` | Retweet a tweet by ID |
| `comment` | Comment on a tweet by ID |
| `mention` | Mention users in a tweet by ID |
| `get_tweet` | Retrieve a specific tweet by ID |
| `get_tweet_comments` | Get all comments for a tweet |
| `get_user_stats` | Get stats for a user |
| `get_user_tweets` | Get all tweets from a user |
| `list_all_following` | List all users the authenticated user follows |
| `follow_user` | Follow a user |
| `unfollow_user` | Unfollow a user |
| `search_tweets` | Search tweets containing a keyword |
| `posting_get_login_status` | Check login status of the current user |
